summary: Custom properties (CSS variables) store a value with a name like --club-blue. Read the value with var(--club-blue). Change it in one place and every rule that uses it updates.
notes: Variables set on :root work everywhere on the page, so they are a good home for the site's colors and spacing.
The second value in var(--accent, var(--club-blue)) is a fallback. The web card has no --accent, so it uses blue.
.games { --accent: #a33a00; } changes the accent only inside the games card. The heading and border both follow it.
pitfall: Leaving off the dashes or var(): color: club-blue; or color: --club-blue; is invalid and the browser ignores it.
